Body, health & movement

eyelid noun

also eyelids

classical

Traupman 58
Cic. N.D. 2.142

palpebra, palpebrae f.

noun, first declension

Examples

  • nam patris, quī etiam tum dormiēbat, palpebram digitō sublevāvit, ut explōrāret num vigilāret

    for he lifted his sleeping father’s eyelid with a finger, to find out whether he was awakeLibellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

See also eyelash, eye, eyebrow.
